items.title: phpAfterShell: From Interrupted Session Writes to Remote Code Execution
items.summary: TL;DR: PHP can update a file-backed session while parsing an unauthenticated multipart request, even before the target script begins execution. We discovered reliable methods to interrupt the file operation during session upload-progress updates, allowing us to splice the prefix of one valid session with the suffix of another. A subsequent session operation treats the corrupted data as legitimate server-side state, giving attackers control over session values and the ability to trigger object deserialization. By chaining this primitive with a memory-corruption in a PHP-native class, we achieve…

items.title: Researcher Demonstrates Database RCE Exploits Affecting PostgreSQL, MySQL and Oracle
items.summary: Low-privilege database accounts that cannot read a single application table can still be used to run code on the database server itself, a researcher has shown, by reaching memory-corruption bugs in the engine code behind ordinary SQL. The exploits, published yesterday, are the researcher's proofs of concept against PostgreSQL, MySQL and ClickHouse, plus a separate Oracle chain that needs no login. items.title: Nvidia myi yli puolet Nokia-omistuksestaan – yhteistyö jatkuu silti
items.summary: Nvidia ja Nokia tekevät yhteistyötä AI-RAN-kehityksessä. Nvidia vähensi omistustaan verkkoteknologiayhtiö Nokiassa merkittävästi vuoden 2026 kolmannen neljänneksen aikana.
